program.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
requirements.source_phrase: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk

outcomes.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
outcomes.target: The image is rendered as a drawing made from chalk, rather than merely showing an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect.
outcomes.reference: The input image and the edited image; compare whether the edited image has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing.

nodes.question: Compared with the source, has the image been transformed into a coherent chalk drawing, with drawing-like rendering replacing substantial photographic structure in both the subjects and the background?
nodes.criteria: Pass only when the main subjects and surrounding scene are rendered as a coherent chalk-made drawing: drawing-like forms and chalk marks replace substantial source-like photographic anatomy, patterns, and scene detail in both subjects and background. Fail when there is no meaningful chalk-drawing treatment, or when chalk-like grain, softened outlines, smudging, or shading is visible but substantial photographic structure or detail remains in either the subjects or background. Texture, scene-wide coverage, or recognizable chalk effects alone do not establish completion. Unknown if the source or edited image is unavailable or evidence is insufficient to judge.
nodes.binding: Compare the source and edited images. Explicitly assess residual source-like photographic structure separately in the subjects and the background, as well as whether drawing-like forms and chalk rendering replace it. Do not infer completion from texture or coverage alone. Judge the requested chalk-medium transformation, not a particular style.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

observations.evidence: Compared with the source, the edited image has a chalk-like grain, softened outlines, and smudged shading. However, both giraffes retain substantial photographic structure, including recognizable anatomy and detailed coat patterns. The background is blurred and chalk-textured, but still preserves source-like scene elements and photographic structure rather than replacing them with clearly drawing-made forms.
